premises.text: Most women face hormone-related issues yet lack guidance on whether cyclical hormonal changes are normal, and non-fertility cyclical hormone data barely exists
premises.evidence_span: 80% of us, that's 3.1 billion women, suffer from a hormone-related issue

premises.text: Hormones must be tested on specific cycle days, but multi-draw blood tests with multi-day lab waits are inconvenient and costly
premises.evidence_span: Today's solution of drawing blood and waiting days for your test results is not a convenient or cost efficient solution as you need multiple blood tests per cycle

premises.text: Hormona combines a patent-pending non-invasive urine test with a mobile app for at-home hormone understanding without a lab
premises.evidence_span: Hormona has invented a test that, combined with our mobile app, empowers women to understand their hormones from the comfort of our home

premises.text: Focus is three key female hormones that determine an individual hormone pattern, with results in about 15 minutes at much lower cost than blood labs
premises.evidence_span: we have nailed down the three most important female hormones to test in order to determine a woman's individual hormone pattern

premises.text: Cycle-based algorithm tells which hormone to test on which days; pee-dip-scan yields quantitative results the app analyzes
premises.evidence_span: the unique hormonal algorithm indicates the three testing days per cycle alongside which hormone to test

premises.text: Quantitative cycle results connect symptoms to hormone levels and supply planning tips and individualized treatments
premises.evidence_span: allows women to see their unique hormone pattern. and understand how symptoms connect to their hormone levels. They can also get tips on how to plan their life around their cycle and treatments based on their individual needs

premises.text: Regular monitoring enables predictions and earlier detection of menopause timing, fertility issues, and other overlooked hormonal changes, contributing to a women's hormone baseline for medicine
premises.evidence_span: Hormona can, with time, help to confirm if you're going into menopause, will have problems getting pregnant, or pick up any hormonal changes that may impact your life

domains.name: Blind cyclical hormone care and blood-test friction
At-home urine test and cycle app
Longitudinal hormone baseline and early detection

value.text: Empower women to understand and act on their hormones from home with convenient accurate affordable testing
value.evidence_span: empowers women to understand their hormones from the comfort of our home

secondary_value.text: Create the hormonal baseline medicine will work from and narrow the gender data gap
secondary_value.evidence_span: Hormona is creating the hormonal baseline that medicine will be working off of
